what: Once the concentric-circle plate around the center logo is 30% in view — the innermost circle stays as is, and from the second circle on they light up at .2s intervals, growing from .8× transparent to 1× (.6s ease-out). After all the circles are on (.8s), the four surrounding cards spread all at once into place from a .8× transparent position pulled 100px toward the center (.6s ease-out) — a system intro plate where one product spreads out into many features

options.dur: Time for circles and cards to turn on (sec), default .6
options.gap: Delay between circles (seconds), default .2 — the card waits one more beat (gap) after the last circle
options.pull: Distance (px) the cards are pulled toward the center, default 100
options.keep: Number of inner circles on from the start, default 1
options.threshold: How much of the panel must be visible to start (0~1), default .3
options.[data-fx-part=hub]: Center the cards fan out from (logo plate) — defaults to the element’s center
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Concentric circles (from the inside) — position transform (translate(-50%,-50%) etc.) is kept as is if set in the consuming style

from.where: index.html system intro (.hc-sys — circles 278·358·469·596px, four cards in a 2×2 grid with gaps 155·184px)
